snippet.title: 7 Trips, All Safe 🚣 Riddle #7 Answer + Riddle #8: 2 Fathers, 2 Sons, 3 Fish #shorts
snippet.description:
Yesterday's answer: take the goat across, then come back alone. Take the wolf across, but bring the goat back. Leave the goat and take the cabbage across (the wolf does not eat cabbage). Come back alone, then take the goat across one last time. 7 trips, and all three are safe on the other side.

Riddle #8: Two fathers and two sons go fishing together. They catch exactly three fish. Each of them takes home one whole fish, and nobody shares. How is that possible?

Comment your answer. The answer drops tomorrow, at sunrise. 🌅

#riddle #brainteaser #logicpuzzle #puzzle #shorts
